description: This file 'SystemServicesHelper.cpp' contains utility functions and helper methods for system services, including error code mappings, file operations, system information retrieval, string utilities, and JSON response construction, tailored for a software project involving system management and network operations.

methods.name: getErrorDescription
methods.description: Returns a descriptive string for a given system error code based on an internal mapping.

methods.name: dirnameOf
methods.description: Extracts the directory part of a given file path.

methods.name: dirExists
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists at the specified path.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Reads the first line from a specified file into a string.

methods.name: populateResponseWithError
methods.description: Fills a JSON response object with error status and message.

methods.name: caseInsensitive
methods.description: Performs case-insensitive extraction of model information from a string.

methods.name: ltrim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the beginning of a string.

methods.name: rtrim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the end of a string.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from both ends of a string.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves device model information by executing a shell script.

methods.name: convertCase
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Checks if a firmware string contains a specified substring, case-insensitively.

methods.name: setJSONResponseArray
methods.description: Constructs a JSON array from a vector of strings and attaches it to a JSON object.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Reads entire content of a file into a string or vector of strings.

methods.name: searchAndGetFilesList
methods.description: Searches a directory for files matching a filter and returns a list of filenames.

methods.name: strcicmp
methods.description: Performs case-insensitive comparison of two C strings.

methods.name: findCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a substring within a string, case-insensitively.

methods.name: getXconfOverrideUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration URL override from a specified file.

methods.name: getTimeZoneDSTHelper
methods.description: Reads timezone information from a system file.

methods.name: getTimeZoneAccuracyDSTHelper
methods.description: Reads timezone accuracy info, defaulting if invalid.

methods.name: currentDateTimeUtc
methods.description: Returns the current system time in UTC formatted string.

methods.name: url_encode
methods.description: Encodes a URL string for safe transmission.

methods.name: urlEncodeField
methods.description: Encodes a string for URL field inclusion, using curl handle.

methods.name: writeCurlResponse
methods.description: Processes curl response data into a string stream.

methods.name: findMacInString
methods.description: Extracts a MAC address from a string based on an ID.

methods.name: enableXREConnectionRetentionHelper
methods.description: Creates or removes a retention status file for XRE connection.

methods.name: stringTodate
methods.description: Converts string representation of date/time to a formatted string.

methods.name: removeCharsFromString
methods.description: Removes specified characters from a string.

methods.name: curl_write
methods.description: A curl write callback function for handling response data.

methods.name: parseConfigFile
methods.description: Parses key-value pairs from a configuration file.
